descriptions.d24f_word_vector_fill_insert_80350a78: Inserts n copies of a word at pos in a vector (start +0, finish +4, storage end +12). With spare capacity it moves the tail up with memmove and fills; otherwise it allocates max(size, n) more elements through 0x801907a8, copies prefix, fills, copies suffix, releases old storage via 0x801907d0 and sets the new bounds.
